description: A 3-word text where the first word is codemix-eligible (substituted to an English word) and the last two words are an approved abbreviate bigram (neither in codemix's wordbank, so codemix running first per NOISER_ORDER doesn't consume either of them). Confirms n_substitutions correctly SUMS both stages' contributions (1 + 1 = 2), not just the last stage's; that codemix running before abbreviate doesn't accidentally block a bigram it has no wordbank entry for; and that the two get visibly DIFFERENT script treatment in the final text -- codemix's English word stays Latin, abbreviate's initials stay Sinhala ('න. හා.', never romanized regardless of mixed_script_rate).
